fields.title: Service WVTR
fields.finding: No installed laminate rate at48.79C, cyclic cold/heat and service water pressure is measured. Twofold rate defeats the R10 seven-day SiOx/3A closure.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure WVTR of the final aged, strained and seamed stack across actual T/RH; target<=0.08551g/m2/day for7days or<=0.01614 for30days in the stated R10 mass account.

claim: No installed laminate rate at48.79C, cyclic cold/heat and service water pressure is measured. Twofold rate defeats the R10 seven-day SiOx/3A closure. | Service WVTR

qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying.
